definitions.explanation: Being moderate or restrained in behavior, expression, or quantity. Avoiding excess or drawing attention to oneself.

examples.japanese: {控|ひか}え{目|め}な{性格|せいかく}
{彼女|かのじょ}は{控|ひか}え{目|め}に{見積|みつも}っても{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ。
examples.english: Even by modest estimation, she is excellent.

examples.japanese: {塩分|えんぶん}は{控|ひか}え{目|め}にしてください。
examples.english: Please go easy on the salt.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {控|ひか}え{目|め}な{人|ひと}.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {控|ひか}え{目|め}に (modestly, in moderation)

NUANCE: {控|ひか}え{目|め} is generally positive when describing personality (modest, unassuming) but can be neutral when describing quantities (moderate amount). It's valued in Japanese culture as a sign of good manners.

ORTHOGRAPHY: Also written as {控|ひか}えめ or ひかえめ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}な{性格|せいかく} (reserved personality)
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}に{見積|みつも}っても (even by modest estimation)
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}にする (to moderate, go easy on)
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}な{態度|たいど} (modest attitude)

RELATED WORDS:
- {謙虚|けんきょ} (humble, modest)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}がち (reserved, hesitant)
- {地味|じみ} (plain, subdued)
- {おとなしい} (quiet, gentle)
